article.title: Bar against direct demand on assessee.
article.content: Where tax is deductible at the source under this Chapter, the assessee shall not be called upon to pay the tax himself to the extent to which tax has been deducted from that income.
article.html:
401Bar against direct demand on assessee.

Section 401 · Chapter XIX · B.—Deduction and collection at source · page 480 of the Act

Where tax is deductible at the source under this Chapter, the assessee shall not be called upon to pay the tax himself to the extent to which tax has been deducted from that income.
